_about: Offline-first policy of Moworks Motion (user decision 04-05/10/2026). Every launcher and the HyperFrames adapter apply this before running anything.

forbidden: CDN script or font loads during preview/render (vendor everything)
AI vision or TTS APIs on client material

hyperframes_update: our updater (engine/adapters/hf) checks npm itself, installs the new version into its own folder, runs the smoke test, keeps the previous version and rolls back on failure; projects in progress keep their version. HF's own update check and auto-install stay off.
client_material: never leaves the machine; rembg and whisper run offline
drive: heavy work files, caches and the HyperFrames install live in %USERPROFILE%\.aimotionkit (throw-away, rebuilt by the installer); everything the kit needs (code, libraries, assets, fonts) lives in the kit folder; finished deliverables are copied into Projects\<name>\ on Drive
